units: <cite ref="Pesikta Rabbati 36">Pesik. R. s. 36</cite>; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 359">Yalk. Is. 359</cite> <he>ומְשַׁנְּקִין את רוחך בעול</he> and they shall choke thy spirit (curb thy energies) with a yoke.

senses.gloss: to be strangled. Pesik. Zutr., Ḥuck., p. 244 ולא היינו מִשְׁתַּנְּקִין בצמא and we should not have been choked by thirst.
